messages.subject: Use both, coord_cartesian and coord_equal
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to zoom into a plot (geom_raster). Thus
I found coord_cartesian() very useful. On the other
hand as it is a raster the ratio between the two
axis should be fixed which can be done by coord_equal().

But how I can I use them both in one plot? What is the
correct order of the commands? I seems that one overwrites
the other...

Here an example:

p <- qplot(disp, wt, data=mtcars)
p + geom_smooth()+
coord_equal(ratio=100/1)+
coord_cartesian(xlim = c(325, 500))

How do I set the coords correctly?

/johannes

messages.subject: Re: Use both, coord_cartesian and coord_equal
parts: Perhaps you can set the limix by coord_equal:

p + geom_smooth()+ coord_equal(ratio=100/1, xlim = c(325, 500))


2012/5/9 Johannes Radinger <JRad...@gmx.at>:

> p <- qplot(disp, wt, data=mtcars)
> p +     geom_smooth()+
>        coord_equal(ratio=100/1)+
>        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(325, 500))
